name: NGC 1460 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1460, a lenticular galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc310-hubble
story: NGC 1460 is a lenticular galaxy, a class that falls between spirals and ellipticals. Hubble imaged it as one of 43 early-type galaxies in the Fornax Cluster.

claims.text: FCC 310 is a lenticular galaxy observed by the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey
FCC 310 is NGC 1460, type SB0 (barred lenticular)
Lenticular galaxies are a class between spirals and ellipticals
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey imaged 43 early-type galaxies in the Fornax Cluster with Hubble
The survey was designed to study the role of environment
